The Health and Social Care Act 2012

texts.77dccc86cd9f: To maintain confidential paediatric and obstetric registers for the national surveillance of HIV and AIDS.  To monitor and assess and to provide obstetricians and paediatricians with up to date data on HIV/AIDS epidemic in women and children, and with information on the major issues of treatment and prevention. By flagging study members changes in treatment practice and the Long term sequelae of fetal/childhood exposure to antiretrovial therapy will be monitored.
texts.d3be5b62c0c8: The data supplied by the NHS IC to UCL Institute of Child Health will be used only for the approved Medical Research Project, National Mother and Child Cohort.
